description: This file defines an abstract class 'ProfileCondition' that implements Spring's 'Condition' interface. It provides a method to check if certain profiles are active within a Spring environment, delegating the actual match logic to subclasses via an abstract method.

classes.name: ProfileCondition
classes.description: An abstract class implementing Spring's 'Condition' interface, used to create profile-based conditions in Spring configuration.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Overrides the 'matches' method from the 'Condition' interface. Retrieves active profiles from the environment and delegates the matching logic to subclasses.

methods.name: matches (abstract)
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to define specific profile matching logic based on a list of active profile names.
